response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years of software development experience, solid TypeScript/Node.js and cloud (AWS CDK) skills, and recent hands-on work with MCP servers and agentic-workflow tooling. However, his GenAI experience appears to span roughly one year, far short of the required 8+ years building AI-driven solutions, and the resume shows no evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, Python, evaluation pipelines, or leading customer-facing technical discovery — core requirements for this forward-deployed staff role.
strengths: Recent hands-on experience with MCP code generators and agentic-workflow infrastructure
Deep full-stack and production engineering background (TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, high-throughput systems)
Demonstrated mentorship and knowledge-sharing through workshops, courses, and conference talks
concerns: Falls well short of the required 8+ years building AI-driven solutions (~1 year of GenAI work)
No demonstrated experience with RAG, vector databases, LLM evaluation, or multi-agent frameworks
No evidence of customer-facing technical discovery or forward-deployed consulting experience; Python not listed

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering seniority and mentorship record
